name: Catherine Williams
source:

Her best friend is Sophia and she is good friends with Aaliyah. Cat and Sophia sometimes also hang out with Isabella. They have tried to befriend Polly, but Polly's angry and sullen mood have made it impossible.

She enjoys watching MC with other women, masturbating while watching. At the same time she has a jealous streak, especially when it comes to girls around her own age; she fears that they would somehow be "better" than her.
